newHelp: Clear the current question and stop voice. The latest completed answer, sources, sign-in, scope, action forms and operation history are kept.
newDone: Ready for a new question. Completed evidence, sign-in, scope, action forms and operation history are unchanged.
newBusy: Please wait for the current request or confirmation, or connect an authorized scope. Nothing has been cleared.
voiceIntro: Ask naturally. Explore the answer together.
voiceUnavailable: Voice is unavailable in this view. Typed chat remains available.
vpnStatus: VPN status is not checked here. A signed-in account does not confirm private-network connectivity.
hostWaiting: Waiting for the app connection status.
hostOpenVoice: Open Chat In Browser for Voice
hostUnavailable: The app connection is unavailable. Reopen Agent Chat in the app.
subtitle: Scoped guidance. Evidence first. Actions by approval.
welcome: What can we help you build?
welcomeIntro: Explore architecture, onboard a project, or understand your operations — with guidance for your active scope.
composerHint: Enter to send · Shift + Enter for a new line
feedbackLocal: Feedback marked locally for this message; it has not been sent.
copyFailed: Could not copy the message. Select its text and copy manually.
deleteHelp: This removes the message from this page only. Server records, actions and operation history are unchanged.
messageDeleted: Message removed from this page. Server records and actions are unchanged.
messageChanged: The message changed while confirmation was open. Review it again before deleting.
evidenceIntro: Sources and context for the latest checked answer.
transcriptHelp: Live speech is provisional. Checked answers and sources appear in the conversation.
actionsIntro: Existing permissions and confirmations still apply. Selecting a view never grants access.
viewHelp: Change the explanation audience, not your permissions.
fallback: The companion layout is unavailable for this page version. The original interface and all its controls remain available.
